actions.name: false appearance
actions.desc: While the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a cave formation such as a stalactite or stalagmite.

actions.name: crush
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage extended]]. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} attaches to the target. If the target is Medium or smaller and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has advantage on the attack roll, it attaches by engulfing the target's head, and the target is also &reference[blinded] and unable to &reference[suffocating]{Breathe} while the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is attached in this way. While attached to the target, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can attack no other creature except the target but has advantage on its attack rolls. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s speed also becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed, and it moves with the target. A creature can detach the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} by making a successful [[/check activity=D6cM30tTL0VfB4x1]] check as an action. On its turn, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can detach itself from the target by using 5 feet of movement.

actions.name: darkness aura
actions.desc: A [[lookup @labels.description.template activity=QwLySmRaYcAPebjO]] of magical &reference[darkness] extends out from the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, moves with it, and spreads around corners. The darkness lasts as long as the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} maintains concentration, up to [[lookup @labels.duration activity=QwLySmRaYcAPebjO]] (as if concentrating on a spell). &reference[Darkvision] can't penetrate this darkness, and no natural light can illuminate it. If any of the darkness overlaps with an area of light created by a spell of 2nd level or lower, the spell creating the light is dispelled.

actions.name: echolocation
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't use its &reference[blindsight] while &reference[deafened apply=false].
